My Ecomm Grandmaster, I started learning DR copywriting 6 months ago (from halbert) and i practice it on the side while doing ecomm. Do you think AI will ever become so good at copywriting that it becomes obsolete to even learn?

I will never say "AI can't do something" but i will say this...

I really used to think that DR was gonna get totally commoditized by AI because the access to that information was becoming incredibly easy. 

but with these new done for you AI marketing tools I think we'll just see more AI marketing slop. Stuff that looks cool but doesn't convert bc it neglects DR principles and fundamentals.

which is fantastic news for me and anyone that's actually skilled in DR.

It’s already shifting that way, man. I used to spend days crafting hooks and scripts for my ecomm stores, but lately, leveraging AI UGC video tools changed everything. It doesn't just write the copy; it actually generates high-converting video ads with realistic avatars in any language. Tested it on my own products, and the sales skyrocketed globally because the marketing feels so native. If you want to see what's actually working right now, I left the link to the tool I use in my bio. Total game-changer for scaling

I don't think so (not in the near future at least).

The thing is that most people despise AI generated content (copy and images). 

That's because psychologically we want to know we're interacting with other humans. 

How anoying it is to call a company and get a robot to answer your questions.

Up to this point (quite a few years now), AI has been unable to sound human without a human editing it. 

So no, learning copywriting and becoming good at it will never become obsolete.

Plus, if you use the prompts everybody is giving you for free to write copy, how do you pretend to stand out as a brand? People will get sick of the same info. Especially if you don't know copywriting principles and don’t know how to edit it.

In my country, many restaurants are using the same image template generated by ChatGPT and people are saying they skip those ads.

@deF4vlt  That's amazing, 

I personally love learning DR, it is so much fun, for now I just write by hand, and as i write more and more i start to see patterns that are used by the best copywriters.

I used to think copywriting was the most boring profession lol, im so glad i started with copywriting and then came into ecomm.

And I totally agree about the human aspect. 90% of the copy,  you can tell just by reading the first line that it was written by AI. 

But sometimes what surprises me is how even brands that are making decent money have not so good copywriting.

With AI, i think its easier than ever to make money, not because of AI, but because of the fact its easy to stand out with good copywriting and win.
